strategyOwner: Alexei Malashkevich / GTMx outbound (Isla Brooks thread)
headline: Your Akveo waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing mid-market buyers across Akveo’s named verticals into the right AI PoC, dedicated-team, leadership-build, or soft consulting offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Alexei Malashkevich.
productSummary: Akveo (akveo.com) is an AI development and full-cycle software engineering agency (not a SaaS product). Since 2015 (USA, Poland, Lithuania) they sell AI Strategy, Agentic AI / RAG, Workflow Automation, AI-Ready Modernization, and AI-Native web/mobile/SaaS builds. Engagement tiers on the homepage: AI Consulting (2 weeks, fixed fee); AI PoC (typically $15K, 4–6 weeks); Production Build (from $60k, 3–5 months); AI Care (monthly retainer); AI-Augmented Engineers (onboard 1–2 weeks). Dedicated teams page: build a dedicated software development team in 7 days. Public proof: 200+ projects / Trusted by 200+ clients including PwC, ZF, Goldie; $1.6B+ client valuation growth; 2x faster delivery with AI-native process; 70+ senior experts; Factory Copilot — 50% faster data retrieval / 2x faster access to production data; Wealthfluent AI assistant — 100% regulatory compliance; Smart Parking — +400% user growth; 95% partners continue beyond initial scope and 70%+ stay 2+ years. Named verticals: Digital Health / Healthcare, Manufacturing, IoT, Automotive, Finance, Insurance, Logistics, EdTech, Construction, Professional services, Energy. Isla’s thread already offered a free first campaign and a 5-page Akveo-specific doc; Alexei asked for more info + docs on how the work could look.
coreInsight: Alexei sells one AI-native engineering partner, not ten vertical products. Healthcare vs Manufacturing vs Finance is a merge tag after routing, not a second waterfall. The single routing signal is eng_ai_hiring_state from LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape: open AI/ML roles, open software-engineering roles, product/engineering-leadership hiring, or none of those. That ladder maps to Akveo’s live engagement models (AI PoC / Agentic, Dedicated Team in 7 days, Production Build from $60k, AI Consulting soft entry) and to Isla’s thread angles: high-intent buyers who need build capacity, personalisation on stack and scope, reliability vs speed A/B.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is which eng / AI roles they are hiring for
sections.takeaway: LinkedIn Jobs + a careers scrape already names AI/ML roles, software-engineering IC roles, product/engineering leadership openings, or none of those. That eng_ai_hiring_state is stronger than a title guess and cheap to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM mid-market buyer
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Open AI/ML roles first, then software-engineering IC roles, then product/engineering leadership hiring, then every remaining in-TAM company across Akveo’s named verticals.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each hiring state gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: AI hiring gets an AI PoC / Agentic Brief. Eng IC hiring gets a Dedicated Team Brief. Leadership hiring gets an AI Opportunity Audit. The rest get the soft AI-Native Build Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: PoC the AI hire, staff the eng backlog, brief the new leader, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always mid-market buyers in Akveo’s named verticals. Vertical is a merge tag. A/Bs sit on exclusive routes (speed vs reliability from Isla’s thread).

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the open role already on LinkedIn
sections.takeaway: Notice the AI, eng, or leadership hire, poke the capacity / time-to-market pain that state implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the AI-hiring route first
sections.takeaway: Start where they already post AI/ML roles and still face 3–6 month hire cycles versus a 4–6 week PoC. Prove reply density, then roll eng IC hiring, leadership hiring, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo + LinkedIn Sales Nav / LinkedIn Jobs filtered to Akveo’s named verticals (Digital Health, Manufacturing, IoT, Automotive, Finance, Insurance, Logistics, EdTech, Construction, Professional services, Energy) and mid-market headcount is the commercial TAM Alexei already sells into. Public TAM account count is not published on akveo.com; treat size as estimated (see akveo-magnet-flags.txt) and keep each launch tier ≥~1,500 contacts where possible.

The same Jobs + careers pull returns eng_ai_hiring_state: AI/ML/LLM/Data/RAG engineer titles; software IC titles (full-stack, backend, frontend, mobile); product/engineering leadership titles — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live Akveo engagement models on akveo.com: AI PoC (typically $15K, 4–6 weeks) and Agentic AI for AI hiring; Dedicated Team in 7 days / Production Build from $60k for eng IC hiring; AI Consulting (2 weeks) for leadership / opportunity audits; soft AI-Native Build Playbook for remaining TAM — plus Isla’s reliability vs cost/speed A/B.
Buyer title (CTO / VP Eng / Head of Product / COO / CEO) and vertical are scrape filters and merge tags, not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the account is routed.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs + company careers pages
sources.delivers: eng_ai_hiring_state in one pull: AI/ML/LLM/Data/RAG open roles (Tier 1), software IC open roles (Tier 2), product/engineering leadership open roles (Tier 3). Primary routing signal.

sources.name: Apollo + LinkedIn Sales Nav (vertical + headcount filters)
sources.delivers: In-TAM mid-market accounts across Akveo’s named verticals plus buyer titles (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Product, COO, CEO). The TAM spine.

sources.name: Optional Crunchbase / funding filter (enrichment, not required to route)
sources.delivers: Recent funding as a soft prioritisation boost inside a tier — never a second waterfall axis.

sources.name: Company site / tech blog / stack pages (optional personalisation)
sources.delivers: stack_hint and modernization language for copy merge tags after routing. Do not use absence-of-tool as a tier trigger.

sources.delivers: Work emails for already-routed accounts. Do not buy a raw ‘CTO list’ and hope.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND ai_role_open = true (LinkedIn Jobs / careers lists AI Engineer, ML Engineer, LLM / GenAI, Data Scientist / Data Engineer for AI, RAG, Prompt Engineer, or equivalent) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are already buying AI build capacity via hiring. Strongest intent for Akveo’s AI PoC (typically $15K, 4–6 weeks), Agentic AI / RAG, or AI-Augmented Engineers (1–2 week onboard) versus a 3–6 month hire cycle. Proof: Factory Copilot 50% faster data retrieval; Wealthfluent 100% regulatory compliance.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND eng_ic_role_open = true (software IC: Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, Mobile, Platform, DevOps) AND no Tier-1 AI roles AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are hiring builders, not AI specialists — pain is backlog and time-to-ship. Maps to Dedicated Team in 7 days and Production Build from $60k / 3–5 months on akveo.com. 2x faster delivery claim and 200+ projects are the proof path.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND leadership_role_open = true (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Product / Digital / Innovation, Engineering Manager) AND no Tier 1–2 IC / AI roles AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are buying leadership capacity or replacing a tech lead — softest high-intent before catch-all. Maps to AI Consulting (2 weeks, fixed fee) and a scoped PoC recommendation, not a full production pitch on Day 0.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (named verticals, mid-market digital buyers). Soft CTA around AI-native builds, modernization, and a free first conversation. Mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Open AI / ML / LLM / Data-for-AI roles
tiers.trigger: LinkedIn Jobs or careers page lists AI Engineer, ML Engineer, LLM/GenAI, Data Scientist/Engineer for AI, RAG, Prompt Engineer, or equivalent; not already an Akveo customer
tiers.pain: They already decided AI capacity is urgent, but open roles mean months of recruiting while the PoC / agent / RAG backlog sits — competitors shipping assistants and copilots pull ahead.
tiers.valueProp: AI PoC / Agentic Brief: Akveo AI PoC typically $15K in 4–6 weeks, Agentic AI / RAG that cuts repetitive tasks 30–50% (homepage), AI-Augmented Engineers onboard in 1–2 weeks — anchored to Factory Copilot (50% faster data retrieval) and Wealthfluent (100% regulatory compliance).
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape for AI/ML/LLM/Data-for-AI titles
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already buy AI build capacity via hiring
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on akveo.com — keep each tier ≥~1,500 contacts before launch when the niche allows

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Open software IC roles, no AI roles
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company posts Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, Mobile, Platform, or DevOps IC roles with no Tier-1 AI titles
tiers.pain: Engineering hiring is open because the product backlog outruns the team — every unfilled seat is delayed releases, tech debt, and stalled modernization.
tiers.valueProp: Dedicated Team Brief: Akveo dedicated software development team in 7 days; Production Build from $60k / 3–5 months; AI-native delivery up to 2x faster (homepage). 200+ projects and 95% partners continuing past initial scope as social proof.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape for software IC titles after AI-role filter fails
tiers.replyDensity: High - visible build demand, stack not locked to an AI hire

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Product / engineering leadership hiring only
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company posts CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Product/Digital/Innovation, or Engineering Manager with no Tier 1–2 AI or software IC roles
tiers.pain: They are buying leadership or replacing a tech lead — strategy and vendor choices land before headcount. A wrong first AI bet wastes a quarter.
tiers.valueProp: AI Opportunity Audit: Akveo AI Consulting in 2 weeks (fixed fee) that names where a PoC creates value, then a scoped AI PoC recommendation — not a production pitch on Day 0.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers for leadership titles after Tier 1–2 filters fail
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - clear buying window, longer education cycle

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM mid-market buyers
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company in Akveo’s named verticals with a CTO / VP Eng / Head of Product / COO / CEO decision maker and no Tier 1–3 eng_ai_hiring_state
tiers.pain: Day-to-day ops still run on manual workflows and legacy stack, so AI and modernization stay on the ‘someday’ list while peers ship copilots and automate document work.
tiers.valueProp: Soft AI-Native Build Playbook: how peers in {{vertical}} start with Consulting or a narrow PoC, then Production / AI Care — 200+ projects, $1.6B+ client valuation growth, soft CTA.
tiers.dataSource: Apollo / Sales Nav after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; catch-all must cover remaining TAM
